info.title: pro3d-tool
info.description: Command line tools for PRo3D data: OPC validation and KdTree generation, per-pixel illumination geometry, unprojecting image pixel coordinates onto a shape model, simulated instrument images, and assembling several instruments' images onto a shape model.

commands.name: kdtree
commands.description: Validate OPC directories and generate KdTrees.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Prints all messages to standard output.

options.name: --forcekdtreerebuild
options.description: Forces rebuild and overwrites existing kd-trees

options.name: --ignore-master-kd-tree
options.description: Ignores master kd-trees and load or creates per-patch kd-trees as well as the lazy kd-tree cache

options.name: --generatedds
options.description: Generate DDS

options.name: --skip-patch-validation
options.description: Skip patch validation (textures, aara files)

options.name: --overwritedds
options.description: Overwrite DDS

options.name: --degrees-of-parallelism
options.description: Hierarchies to process concurrently: 1 is sequential, 0 (default) or -1 uses all available cores

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: unproject

options.name: --opc
options.description: OPC directory of the body

options.name: --images

options.name: --input

options.name: --observer

options.name: --kernel

commands.name: simulate-image
commands.description: Render a simulated instrument image of a body: OPC geometry, Lommel-Seeliger sun lighting, procedural micro-structure, cast shadows, optional de-shaded texture albedo.

options.name: --opc
options.description: OPC directory of the body

options.name: --time
options.description: Observation time, ISO-8601 UTC (e.g. 2027-03-15T12:00:00Z). Required unless --mbi supplies the observation.

options.name: --mbi
options.description: Render the camera an existing image's .mbi.json sidecar defines, instead of a SPICE look-at camera at --time. Takes the image file or the sidecar; the epoch, instrument and pointing all come from it, so the result is directly comparable with that image.

options.name: --write-mbi
options.description: Also write <out>.mbi.json and <out>.json describing the camera used, so the render can be imported into the PRo3D viewer and projected back onto the same body

options.name: --aim
options.description: Turn the instrument onto the centre of this SPICE body (e.g. DIMORPHOS, DIDYMOS) instead of the planned pointing, keeping the planned roll. THE FRAME IS THEN NOT THE PLANNED OBSERVATION: the sidecar records it as PRO3DAIM. See the docs before using it

options.name: --product
options.description: Write the instrument's delivered product layout instead of a PNG, with its .mbi.json: for HERA_HSH one <out>_Stacked.tif of 25 float bands (HyperScout 1B), for MILANI_ASPECT_NIR1 37 float <out>_<band>.tif (ASPECT 2B). The band values are the render's I/F times a made-up spectrum. No effect for AFC

options.name: --out
options.description: Output PNG path (default: ./simulated.png); with --product, the extension is dropped and the rest is the file stem

options.name: --instrument
options.description: SPICE instrument frame whose frustum to render with (default HERA_AFC-1)

options.name: --observer
options.description: Spacecraft carrying the instrument (default: the one --instrument flies on -- MILANI for ASPECT, HERA otherwise)

options.name: --body
options.description: SPICE body name of the OPC (default DIMORPHOS)

options.name: --frame
options.description: Body-fixed reference frame (default DIMORPHOS_FIXED)

options.name: --kernel
options.description: Explicit SPICE metakernel; default: <kernel-root>/mk/hera_plan.tm

options.name: --kernel-root
options.description: SPICE kernel tree: a clone of https://spiftp.esac.esa.int/git/hera.git or its 'kernels' dir. Defaults to $PRO3D_SPICE_KERNELS.

options.name: --distance
options.description: Camera distance in metres, along the direction SPICE puts the spacecraft; 0 (default) uses the spacecraft's real distance [default: 0]

options.name: --width
options.description: Output width; 0 (default) uses the instrument's native width

options.name: --height
options.description: Output height; 0 (default) uses the instrument's native height

options.name: --albedo
options.description: Normal reflectance of the surface (default 0.16, the measured Dimorphos value) [default: 0.16]

options.name: --deshade
options.description: Fit and divide baked-in illumination out of the OPC texture and use it as albedo; default is the constant --albedo (the de-shading is approximate -- see the docs)

options.name: --deshade-layer
options.description: Per-vertex attribute layer carrying the texture brightness, for the de-shading fit (default DRACO)

options.name: --micro-scale
options.description: Feature size of the procedural micro-structure in metres (default 0.5) [default: 0.5]

options.name: --micro-amplitude
options.description: Strength of the procedural normal perturbation, 0 disables (default 0.3) [default: 0.3]

options.name: --ambient
options.description: Ambient floor so the night side is distinguishable from space (default 0.02) [default: 0.02]

options.name: --gain
options.description: Linear I/F -> DN gain; 0 (default) auto-exposes the 99.5th percentile to DN 245 [default: 0]

options.name: --no-shadows
options.description: Skip the sun shadow map; shading then comes from the local sun angle alone

options.name: --no-lighting
options.description: Render a flat white disk instead of a shaded body: the image is then the silhouette, for comparing pointing and shape against a real frame without shading in the way

options.name: --texture-layer
options.description: Which texture layer of the OPC to draw, by name ('DRACO_1') or index ('8'); the names come from the .opcx and are listed if the one given does not match. Default: the patch's own default layer, which is NOT necessarily what a PRo3D scene shows -- a scene stores its own selectedTexture, so the same OPC can render as 'Earth' here and 'DRACO_1' in the viewer. Match this to the scene's selectedTexture before comparing a render against a viewer screenshot.

options.name: --texture-only
options.description: Render the OPC's own texture as this camera sees it: no lighting, and no de-shading fit. Unlike --deshade, which fits a light direction, clamps the result and falls back to a constant albedo where it has no confidence. Use --texture-layer to choose which layer.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project this image onto the body instead of shading it, through PRo3D's projection shader, and render the result. With no --mbi the camera is that image's own, so the output must reproduce the input image -- which is what makes the projection checkable rather than merely plausible.

options.name: --project-shader
options.description: Which projection shader --project goes through: 'single' (default, stableImageProjection -- what sun-angles and the testbeds use) or 'stack' (stableImageProjectionStack, a one-layer stack -- what the viewer renders). Rendering the same image both ways isolates the stack path.

options.name: --shadow-bias
options.description: Shadow-map depth bias in normalized depth (default 0.002); raise against acne, lower against peter-panning [default: 0.002]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: sample-layers
commands.description: Assemble instrument observations (AFC, ASPECT, HyperScout, ...) onto a body: for every OPC vertex, which image sees it, where, under which sun geometry, and every band's value at the nearest pixel. Writes vertices.csv, one CSV per image and one per OPC attribute layer, keyed by vertex id.

options.name: --opc
options.description: OPC directory of the body

options.name: --images
options.description: One or more folders of observations: every .mbi.json with the band files it declares

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory (default: ./sample-layers)

options.name: --attributes
options.description: Per-vertex OPC layers to write as attributes/<name>.csv, comma separated (default Slope; 'none' for none)

options.name: --body
options.description: SPICE body name of the OPC (default: the images' TARGET)

options.name: --frame
options.description: Body-fixed frame the coordinates are in (default <body>_FIXED)

options.name: --observer
options.description: Observing spacecraft; default is derived per image from the instrument

options.name: --kernel
options.description: Explicit SPICE metakernel; overrides the sidecar

options.name: --kernel-root
options.description: SPICE kernel tree. Defaults to $PRO3D_SPICE_KERNELS.

options.name: --method
options.description: Projection method: spice or mbi (default mbi)

options.name: --occlusion-tolerance
options.description: A vertex counts as hidden only if something lies on its line of sight more than this many metres in front of it (default 0.05) [default: 0.05]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
